arxiv-1411-5469.title: The HI Dominated Low Surface Brightness Galaxy KKR17 The HI Dominated Low Surface Brightness Galaxy KKR17 – References 2002
arxiv-1411-5469.creator: M. I. Lam, H. Wu, M. Yang, Z. -M. Zhou, W. Du, Y. -N. Zhu
arxiv-1411-5469.description: Abstract We present new narrow-band (H α \alpha and [OIII]) imagings and optical spectrophotometry of HII regions for a gas-rich low surface brightness irregular galaxy, KKR 17. The central surface brightness of the galaxy is μ 0 ​ ( B ) \mu_{0}(B) = 24.15 ± \pm 0.03 mag sec -2 .

arxiv-2105-03367.title: CMB Mode Coupling with Isotropic Polarization Rotation 2021 CMB Mode Coupling with Isotropic Polarization Rotation – References
arxiv-2105-03367.creator: Toshiya Namikawa, Department of Applied Mathematics, Theoretical Physics, University of Cambridge, Wilberforce Road, Cambridge CB3 0WA, United Kingdom
arxiv-2105-03367.description: Abstract We provide a new analysis technique to measure the effect of the isotropic polarization rotation, induced by e.g. the isotropic cosmic birefringence from axion-like particles and a miscalibration of CMB polarization angle, via mode coupling in the cosmic microwave background (CMB).

arxiv-2202-05840.title: On Electromagnetic Turbulence
arxiv-2202-05840.creator: Mario J. Pinheiro
arxiv-2202-05840.description: Abstract Combining a generalized current in the set of Maxwell’s equations offers a useful framework to address the complex phenomena of electromagnetic turbulence. The fluidic-electromagnetic analogy implies that diffraction is the analog phenomenon of EM turbulence and indicates norms to design suitable plasmon circuity to control electromagnetic turbulence in stealth technology and propulsion machines.

arxiv-2312-00481.title: Glued lattices are better quantizers than K 12 K_{12}
arxiv-2312-00481.creator: Erik Agrell, Daniel Pook-Kolb, Bruce Allen
arxiv-2312-00481.description: Abstract 40 years ago, Conway and Sloane proposed using the highly symmetrical Coxeter–Todd lattice K 12 K_{12} for quantization, and estimated its second moment. Since then, all published lists identify K 12 K_{12} as the best 12-dimensional lattice quantizer. Surprisingly, K 12 K_{12} is not optimal: we construct two new 12-dimensional lattices with lower normalized second moments.

arxiv-2404-05462.title: Interactive Formal Specification for Mathematical Problems of Engineers
arxiv-2404-05462.creator: Walther Neuper
arxiv-2404-05462.description: Abstract The paper presents the second part of a precise description of the prototype that has been developed in the course of the ISAC project over the last two decades. This part describes the “specify-phase”, while the first part describing the “solve-phase” is already published. In the specify-phase a student interactively constructs a formal specification.

arxiv-2407-16155.title: von Neumann and Newman Pokers with Finite Decks
arxiv-2407-16155.creator: Tipaluck Krityakierne, Thotsaporn Aek Thanatipanonda, Doron Zeilberger
arxiv-2407-16155.description: Abstract John von Neumann studied a simplified version of poker where the “deck” consists of infinitely many cards, in fact, all real numbers between 0 0 and 1 1 . We harness the power of computation, both numeric and symbolic, to investigate analogs with finitely many cards. We also study finite analogs of a simplified poker introduced by D.J.

arxiv-2408-01699.title: Electrostatic Waves and Electron Holes in Simulations of Low-Mach Quasi-Perpendicular Shocks
arxiv-2408-01699.creator: Artem Bohdan, Aaron Tran, Lorenzo Sironi, Lynn B. Wilson III
arxiv-2408-01699.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Artem Bohdan, Aaron Tran, Lorenzo Sironi, Lynn B. Wilson III. Collisionless low Mach number shocks are abundant in astrophysical and space plasma environments, exhibiting complex wave activity and wave-particle interactions. In this paper, we present 2D Particle-in-Cell (PIC) simulations of quasi-perpendicular nonrelativistic ( v sh ≈ ( 5500 − 22000 ) v_{\mathrm{sh}}\approx(5500-22000) km/s) low Mach number shocks, with a specific focus on studying electrostatic waves in the shock ramp and the precursor regions.

arxiv-2411-17607.title: Scaling Speech-Text Pre-training with Synthetic Interleaved Data
arxiv-2411-17607.creator: Aohan Zeng ‡ §*, Zhengxiao Du ‡§*, Mingdao Liu ‡*, Lei Zhao §, Shengmin Jiang §
arxiv-2411-17607.description: Abstract Speech language models (SpeechLMs) accept speech input and produce speech output, allowing for more natural human-computer interaction compared to text-based large language models (LLMs). Traditional approaches for developing SpeechLMs are constrained by the limited availability of unsupervised speech data and parallel speech-text data, which are significantly less abundant than text pre-training data, thereby limiting their scalability as LLMs.

arxiv-2506-05807.title: Center vortices in the novel phase of staggered fermions
arxiv-2506-05807.creator: Jackson A. Mickley, Derek B. Leinweber, Daniel Nogradi
arxiv-2506-05807.description: Abstract The geometry of center vortices is studied in the novel lattice-artefact phase that appears with staggered fermions to elucidate any insight provided by the center-vortex degrees of freedom. For various numbers of fermion flavors, the single-site shift symmetry of the staggered-fermion action is broken in a finite region of the ( β , m ) (\beta,m) phase space.

pmc-12464476.title: Exon 4 and intron 4 TP53 are both methylated in advanced-stage ovarian carcinomas
pmc-12464476.creator: Wiktor Szewczuk, Oksana Szewczuk, Krzysztof Czajkowski, Robert Gromadka, Maciej Waledziak, Marek Semczuk, Andrzej Semczuk
pmc-12464476.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Although intragenic CpG dinucleotides are conserved during evolution, they are also sensitive to methylation-dependent mechanisms. Methylation status of the TP53 introns 1, 3 and 4 have been analysed in stage III ovarian carcinoma (OC). In the present study, the methylation of exon 4 (10 CpG pairs) was analysed in advanced-stage OC to investigate TP53 methylation and compare exon and intron 4 methylation patterns.

pmc-12537949.title: Targeting the Met-RIPK1 signaling axis to enforce apoptosis and necroptosis in colorectal cancer
pmc-12537949.creator: Julian Martin Rossmanith, Jennifer Krummeich, Aurel Moser, Kim Lohmann, Michael Linnebacher, Wilfried Roth, Marie Oliver Metzig
pmc-12537949.description: Resistance to cell death remains a critical challenge in the therapy of colorectal cancer (CRC). Smac mimetics (SM) are cytotoxic agents specifically designed to maximize tumor cell killing mediated via endogenous tumor necrosis factor (TNF). In CRC, however, SM lacked clinical activity for reasons that remain incompletely understood.

pmc-13026277.title: The Effect of Workplace Pressure and Experience on Burnout in Embryologists Working in Assisted Reproduction in Spain
pmc-13026277.creator: Raquel Urteaga, Amelia Díaz
pmc-13026277.description: Highlights Public health relevance—How does this work relate to a public health issue? Approximately 12% of births in Spain are the result of Assisted Reproduction (AR).The work performed by embryologists working in AR is of vital importance in the successful process of AR, consequently, their workplace wellbeing is a public health issue.

pmc-13339993.title: Mindfulness and sustainable diets: a meta-analysis and CO2 emission savings scenarios
pmc-13339993.creator: Anna Kosteletzky, Stephanie Margarete Thomas, Carmen Jochem
pmc-13339993.description: BackgroundDietary habits are a major driver of both human health outcomes and global greenhouse gas emissions, with excessive meat consumption being a key contributor. Mindfulness, understood as purposeful and non-judgmental awareness of the present moment, has been suggested as a psychological factor that can foster more sustainable food choices.

pmc-13416094.title: Persistent racial and socioeconomic inequities in mycosis fungoides survival: a population-based study
pmc-13416094.creator: Tiantian Zhang, Simo Du, Weili Xue, Zhe Wang, Omer A. Idris, Cristina R. Bunton-Young
pmc-13416094.description: Racial disparities in mycosis fungoides (MF) have been described historically, but their persistence in the contemporary era of diagnosis and care remains incompletely characterized. To address this gap, we evaluated survival disparities by race and socioeconomic status (SES) and assessed temporal trends in outcomes.

pmc-13514187.title: Electrical and Dielectric Properties of ZnO-BaO-V2O5 Glasses
pmc-13514187.creator: Tina Tasheva, Ondrej Bošák, Marian Kubliha
pmc-13514187.description: The relationship between composition, structure, and electrical properties is essential for understanding charge transport in vanadate glasses. In this study, the influence of ZnO concentration and thermal treatment on the structure, electrical conductivity, and dielectric relaxation of xZnO–(35 − x)BaO–65V2O5 glasses (x = 0–20 mol%) was systematically investigated.
